title: Diagonal-free first trace rearrangement
statement:
Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and a scheme S where ell is invertible. Let p be a normalized projective-line tower Presentation, d its Maps and h its EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine, as in [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons]. All words below are the actual derived tensor, projection and mate words of [def-sp-tower-p1-triangle-words]. The precise assertion is:
theorem towerP1FirstTraceReordering (p : Presentation l E S hS) (d : Maps l E p)
    (h : EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine l E p d)
    (M : C l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S)) :
    (p.F l E).map (unitTail l E d M) ≫ epsilon l E d ((left l E d).obj M) =
      (p.pushSwap l E).hom.app
        ((SpTowerShriek.tensor l E p.classes.base (diagonalSurface S)).obj
          ((SpTowerShriek.pull l E p.classes.base
            (p.operations.geometry (pullback.fst _ _))).obj M.obj,
            (line l E p.classes.chernW)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) ≫
      (p.F l E).map (contractionTail l E h false M)

proof.text: write L=q*, R=Rq*, a=p1*, b=p2*, U=Rp1*, V=Rp2*, and T=A_P(1)[2]. Use the recorded pullback square to identify aL with bL and its adjunction conjugate pushSwap to identify RV with RU. Form J1 and J2 from RM tensor RT to RU(aM tensor T_W). J1 is the q projection, tensor with the swapped exchange at T, then the p1 projection. J2 is the q projection at (RM,T), tensor with exchange at M, then the p2 projection. Transpose under the composite q/p1 adjunction. Both transposes are tensor comparison followed by a(counit_q at M) tensor b(counit_q at T); counit naturality and tensor bifunctoriality interchange their order. Mate pasting gives equality before transposition, with precisely pushSwap as the right comparison. Compose with the inverse p1 projection and tensor with projectionTrace false. Its definition cancels exchange at T, leaving pullback of the q trace. Projection naturality in the trace and its unit normalization turn this into identity_RM tensor trace_q. Finally cancel J2, which is invertible by Maps.projectionQ, Maps.exchange and Maps.projection2. The remaining word is unitTail followed by epsilon. This proves the displayed equality without a diagonal insertion, a scalar normalization, or the proposed adjunction F left adjoint G.
